verdict.rationale: decK provides declarative, bulk sync of Kong Gateway configuration (services, routes, plugins, consumers) in one operation, verified as a working CLI tool via probe, and Insomnia's Inso CLI/test runner supports 'unlimited test runs simultaneously' and bulk import/export of collections. However, none of this is framed as an AI-native/agent-driven bulk-operation capability—it's traditional DevOps tooling requiring manual CLI or CI usage rather than natural-language or agentic bulk actions.
